sources.title: ReadyArt/gemma-4-31B-it-scotoma · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Findings / what it does scotoma loosens gemma‑4‑31B‑it's cautious reflex. In practice, it produces output that's more varied, direct, and creative, with less of the base model's hedging and assistant persona stiffness. It is not uncensored. The edit removed a bounded region while leaving the rest of the field intact. A blind spot, not blindness.
